name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 36 - Am 120
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 36. Rejects the automatic reinforcement of payment appropriations solely because commitment appropriations have been increased; considers that payment appropriations must be determined line by line on the basis of realistic implementation forecasts, outstanding legal commitments, absorption capacity and verified payment needs;
